[[File:Powertech.png|thumb|right|250px|A powertech in heavy armor.]]
A '''powertech''' was a type of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] that appeared during the years of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed it circa [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Holonet-Bounty Hunter">{{Holonet|classes|bounty-hunter|Bounty Hunter}}</ref> Powertechs wore [[Armor/Legends|powered armor]], served the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and were known for their use of wrist-mounted [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] and [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] as well as their ability to absorb impressive amounts of damage in battle.<ref name="FanFriday">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref>

{{Soldier-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The powertech is an advanced class for the bounty hunter class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in defense, utilizing their custom-made armor, and absorbing damage in battle. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] counterpart for this archetype is the Trooper [[Vanguard advanced training program|vanguard]] specialization.<ref name="FanFriday" />
